adjudication.rationale: In packages/core/EventManager.ts, the catch block at the end of the update flow previously did `console.error(message);` before returning a failure result. The diff removes that `console.error(message)` and does not add any `log.error`/logger call in its place, so failures will now only be reflected via the returned `success: false` results and otherwise produce no log output. This is a real, diff-grounded observability regression, but it does not by itself change the functional outcome of the method (it still returns failure objects).
